visual.general_description: One-year follow-up videonystagmography recording with two stacked eye-position strips without a dense sawtooth pattern.
visual.detailed_description: Two stacked strips with red and blue traces. The upper strip is titled "Horizontal Eye Position [°]" with R and L edge letters and printed degree ticks; the two traces run together and change gradually across the recording with a few step-like offsets and several red triangular markers. The lower strip is titled "Vertical Eye Position [°]" with U and D edge letters; the traces run mostly flat with a late step in both and a small blue triangular marker at the far left. There is no dense repeating sawtooth pattern like the one in Figure 5. No time-axis tick text, names or dates are visible.

visual.general_description: Two cervical VEMP waveform panels, one per ear, with printed stimulus-side labels.
visual.detailed_description: Two side-by-side waveform panels on a dotted grid. The left panel has a dark red label "90 R" at the left edge of its baseline and a brown trace that shows low-amplitude irregular undulations without a distinct biphasic deflection; a tiny label near the end of the trace is too small to read reliably. The right panel has a blue label "90 L" and a blue trace with a distinct biphasic deflection (an upward peak followed by a downward trough) marked by small printed labels P and N with subscripts. The left edge of the left panel prints "-20 µV" at the top and "dB nHL" at the bottom, with small arrow buttons at the top left; each panel has a millisecond x axis with printed ticks -20 to 80 in steps of 10. No names or dates visible.
